# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `datadoe` MCP server pointing at DataDoe's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://mcp.datadoe.com/mcp/v1`).
- Auth uses OAuth with DataDoe user login — no API key to configure.
- Logo: DataDoe's deer icon from the `Deltologic/datadoe-mcp` GitHub repository.
